persona: Plant production planner who became the SAP PP key user
resumeText:
Vikram Patil | Nashik | vikram.patil@example.com

EXPERIENCE
SAP PP Key User, Godavari Auto Components, Nashik (2019 - present)
- Configured MRP Live runs and MRP controllers for the S/4HANA plant rollout.
- Maintained BOMs, routings and work centers for 600 forged parts in SAP PP.
- Mapped as-is and to-be production processes during the S/4HANA migration.
- Wrote and executed UAT scripts for production order confirmation.
- Collected requirements from planners and shop-floor supervisors for capacity reports.
- Trained 40 planners on MD04 and production order confirmation.

Production Planning Engineer, Godavari Auto Components, Nashik (2016 - 2019)
- Planned weekly forging schedules against customer demand.

SKILLS
SAP PP, SAP MM, Excel

EDUCATION
BE Mechanical Engineering, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2016
